Chapter 1 Asha Volkova NORTHUMBERLAND, ENGLAND - 2026
You're coming home after all this time. Couldn't you at least look pleased?
Couldn't you at least look pleased? How long are you going to sulk like a child who's lost her toy?
Hana wasn't a toy. You don't actually think of that girl as family, do you?
You don't actually think of that girl as family, do you? Give up this fantasy of an ordinary life. How long will you remain a child?
How long will you remain a child? Keep the promise you made me.
Welcome back, my niece. Done with your teenage rebellion?
Still not one for pleasantries, I see. Where are we going? I want to show you something.
I want to show you something. Come with me.
What do you think?
What do you think? Your new little sister. Did you have fun on your trip? Nice to meet you. I finally get to meet the sister I’ve heard so much about.
I finally get to meet the sister I’ve heard so much about. Why the hell is she here? Relax. She doesn’t remember a thing from that day.
She doesn’t remember a thing from that day. You’re cruel. Truly. REPUBLIC OF KARELIA, RUSSIA - 2019
REPUBLIC OF KARELIA, RUSSIA - 2019
Hello. Who are you? An old friend of your father’s.
An old friend of your father’s. I'll be taking Asha Volkova with me today.
Even if you were a friend of her father's, I can't hand her over without the proper legal process.
This isn't about the money. If her aunt and uncle find out, I'll be the one held responsible. Then tell them this.
Baekya took her. Understood.
How long are you planning to keep watching Asha? Dangerous things are either removed or kept close.
I chose to keep her close. The same way I chose you. I still can’t believe this is really happening!
A cheerful little one really does liven up the mood, doesn't it? Can I call you unnie? Please? Wouldn’t you agree, my eldest nephew?
Wouldn’t you agree, my eldest nephew?
If you were going to run, you should've stayed gone.
If you were going to run, you should've stayed gone. I'm glad you're alive. That's the first thing you say to me after six years? You really haven't changed.
You really haven't changed. That girl is a lot like you were at her age.
I never smiled like that here. Not the smile. The natural talent... and the cruelty.
You took in the daughter of the man you loved and raised her as a potential successor.
You took in the daughter of the man you loved and raised her as a potential successor. Then you make the daughter of the colleague Jaei killed into Jaei's little sister.
Then you make the daughter of the colleague Jaei killed into Jaei's little sister. Yura, just how much crueler are you planning to get? Sometimes I think you take after Father more than I do.
Sometimes I think you take after Father more than I do. And I'm his own son. Stay out of my affairs and see to your own.
All the while, you keep your own son out there, putting him through trial after trial.
Will you stop running your mouth? Easy. Your little brother's just being honest after a few drinks.
All right, I'm off. If you need anything, you know where to find me. Oh, And do something about that temper.
New YorK, USA - 2029
New YorK, USA - 2029
Sis, you know I saved you again today, right? Come on, admit it. You can't do this without me.
Come on, admit it. You can't do this without me. We nailed the mission. Can't we go somewhere fun for once?
Hey! I was having fun! Can we just ride in silence? Ugh. You're always so serious.
Does killing people really not bother you at all? Sis,
Sis, what's the big deal? It's just a job. Mom says we only kill people who deserve it. You really think she's your mother?
You really think she's your mother? Why would you say that? We're family. All of us. Don't tell me you still don't see me as your little sister.
Don't tell me you still don't see me as your little sister. What about you, then? Did you feel guilty every time you killed someone?
Every time?
Sis... please. Can't you just like me, even a little?
Chapter 2 SHACKLES
Chapter 2 SHACKLES
J. Cleanup confirms everything's been handled. Good work. Are we heading back to base now? No. Something else came up.
Something else came up. Go to Cuba tomorrow and take care of it before you come back. I'll send you the target file as soon as you land in Havana. It's been two months.
It's been two months. How long are we supposed to keep jumping from one mission to the next without a break? I know you're exhausted. But there's too much to do, and no one else I can trust.
and no one else I can trust. Understood. Why?
Why? Something wrong? Did Asha cause trouble again? No.
How much longer am I supposed to keep taking Asha with me? Why? Is she getting on your nerves? You're the one who chose to take her with you.
You're the one who chose to take her with you. That was... And you call yourself her big sister.
And you call yourself her big sister. You can't even handle one little sister?
She's not my sister. J. Don't get confused.
Don't get confused. You chose this. I told you you were free to go back to Korea. You made that promise before I even knew Asha existed!
You made that promise before I even knew Asha existed! I never forced you to stay. Leave now if you want. I have Asha. She's all I need.
I have Asha. She's all I need.
Oh, yes. Now this is what I call a perk.
You're pretty cute, you know that?
What the hell? Are you crazy?
Are you out of your mind? You think this is funny?
Why are you doing this to me…? Please. I'm sorry. Just let me go.
Hey, get up.
What?
Sis... What happened? When did you sneak out? Sis... I messed up. Can you come clean this up for me?
Where are you? Where am I again...?
I don't know.
The game’s blocked. HABANA, CUBA - 2029
HABANA, CUBA - 2029
Welcome to Havana, ladies.
Welcome to Havana, ladies. You're still alive. Good to see you too, J.
Is this a cover, or did Cuba do this to you? How've you been, Asha? Three months in Cuba and I'm practically a local.
Your golden carriage awaits, miss. What is this, an antique?
What is this, an antique? I've never been in one of these. No roof, either. I'm going to fry.
In Cuba, you don't fight the sun. You learn to live with it.
Chapter 3 TRANCADO
It's dangerous. Sit down. You worry too much. I said, sit!
I heard you two worked well together. Nobody mentioned J had learned patience. She still needs work.
Eyes on the road? Got it.
A mojito, please. No. Two mango juices, please. Sis, I'm an adult now.
Sis, I'm an adult now. You drank enough last night. Ugh... I need a drink to kill this hangover.
Make that three, please.
Things are bad here. The power's out more than half the day, and fuel is even worse.
The tourist districts still look fine, but two blocks away, the whole city feels like it's hanging over a cliff.
the whole city feels like it's hanging over a cliff. And the client? GAESA's new executive chairman. Young, careful, and surrounded by people who'd love to see him disappear.
and surrounded by people who'd love to see him disappear.
Is she always like this? You look tired, J.
Yes, they're here. Understood. Your meeting's set. Inside the Capitolio.
Inside the Capitolio. They want you alone. Keep an eye on her for me. Don't worry. Havana's still a pretty safe city.
They're here. Baekya's team arrived with Asha Volkova.
Do not approach Asha yet. Follow them. Nothing more.
I was told Baekya's best operative was young and
I was told Baekya's best operative was young and not exactly easy to get close to. You didn't bring me here to make friends.
This chamber once decided Cuba's future. Now it mostly receives tourists.
Now it mostly receives tourists. These days, not even they can fill it. Cuba was born out of a refusal to be controlled. Then, in the name of protecting that freedom,
Then, in the name of protecting that freedom, we built a state that controlled everything. For sixty years, we survived by refusing every hand held out to us.
For sixty years, we survived by refusing every hand held out to us. Now every hand that reaches for us comes with fingers around our throat.
And you chose Washington's. I chose the side that could still sign an agreement. We can't afford to remain isolated.
We can't afford to remain isolated. Sanctions emptied our shelves. The men in power emptied what was left.
The men in power emptied what was left. GAESA still controls the ports, fuel, and tourism the few arteries that bring hard currency into this country.
Washington is offering limited dollar clearing, fuel credit, and private capital.
Washington is offering limited dollar clearing, fuel credit, and private capital. In return, they want access and a government willing to sign quietly. The public knows none of this.
The public knows none of this. We can keep up the appearance of defending the revolution's pride, or we can keep the lights on.
I no longer have the luxury of pretending they're the same thing. Let's get to the target.
I've said more than I needed to. Russian money has been reaching officers who believe I sold the country.
Russian money has been reaching officers who believe I sold the country. Training, weapons, secure communications. They're building a force inside our own military before the agreement is signed.

They're building a force inside our own military before the agreement is signed. Russian military? Not on paper. It's a mercenary outfit called Severny Kontur. Moscow funds and supports it from a position of plausible deniability.
Moscow funds and supports it from a position of plausible deniability. The man behind it is in that file.
The man behind it is in that file. Mikhail Volkov
You know him? No.
He's operating from an abandoned agricultural complex upriver from the Canímar. The old civil-defense facility beneath it is now an armory and communications center.

The old civil-defense facility beneath it is now an armory and communications center. You want him eliminated? No. He has to be taken alive. Volkov holds the names of the Cuban officers, the Russian handlers,
Volkov holds the names of the Cuban officers, the Russian handlers, the accounts and the timetable. Dead, he gives us a martyr. Alive, he gives us the network
Alive, he gives us the network Where does he go? Straight into American custody. No direct involvement from the Cuban military, no public operation,
no public operation, no body. Officially, none of us ever met in this room. You want a man taken from Cuban soil
You want a man taken from Cuban soil and handed to the United States without Cuba ever admitting it happened. I want him gone before this island becomes someone else's battlefield.
before this island becomes someone else's battlefield. If this becomes public, Washington denies the agreement, Moscow denies the mercenaries, and Havana denounces both while the country burns.
and Havana denounces both while the country burns. I need a result that leaves everyone free to lie.
Understood. I'll report back when it's done.
So who are we killing this time? We're not killing anyone. We take the target alive.
We take the target alive. Alive? Ugh. Boring.
VARADERO, CUBA
Tomorrow could be rough. For tonight, pretend you're tourists and enjoy yourselves.
Does the hotel have mojitos? No. Of course it does. But the mango juice here is excellent.
Oh, J. I left a bike behind the hotel. It's a little beat-up, but it'll get you where you need to go. Have a good night.
Come on, Sis. The water feels amazing.
Asha, listen. You're sitting tomorrow's operation out.
What? I'm going alone. What? Where did that come from? We're a team.
Is this about New York? I told you, it was a mistake. Did you tell Mom?
No. It's an order from above. Liar! This was your call, wasn't it? Tell me I'm wrong.
Tell me I'm wrong. Stay here this time. No arguments. That's ridiculous! You can't just decide that!
Asha... Don't take this the wrong way. Just listen.
What now? What are you trying to say? When this is over... leave Baekya.
Sis, what are you even talking about? I'll help you. Go somewhere else and start over. New name, new life.
New name, new life. Leave all of this behind. With you?
Right. Of course not with you. Why?
Why? Because I'm too much trouble? Is that why you're throwing me away?
Asha... What do you think happens if you give me a new name and a nice apartment?
You think I wake up normal? I know what I am, Sis. I know I'm beyond saving. So don't look at me like that and pretend this is for me.
So don't look at me like that and pretend this is for me. That's not it. I'm trying to give you a chance to choose a different life.
I'm trying to give you a chance to choose a different life. Choice? You don't even know what I want. Now you're trying to decide how I live, too.
Now you're trying to decide how I live, too. What part of that is my choice? Lower your voice. Don't tell me what to do!
For three years, I've been walking on eggshells around you, wondering if you'd ever let me in.
wondering if you'd ever let me in. I worked my ass off trying to be good enough for you. And now you're just throwing me away? I never asked you to.
That's right. You never ask.
You never ask. You leave the door half-open so I follow you, then act like I'm the one who forced my way in. Say it. Just once.
Just once. Have you ever really thought of me as your sister?
No matter how hard you push me away, Baekya is my home and you're still my family! If anyone's leaving, it should be you!
Fine. Go alone. Do whatever you want. I will too.
I'll be back soon. We'll talk when I get back.
Ms. Asha Volkova? Who are you? I have a message for you.
Who sent you? Your uncle is waiting for you. He'd like to see you.
My uncle? LONDON, ENGLAND
LONDON, ENGLAND Your people used to leave silence behind. Lately, they leave rumors.
Lately, they leave rumors. Rumors are what frightened men call evidence they couldn't find. Frightened men move money.
Frightened men move money. I don't pay Baekya to make the room nervous. Don't worry. Baekya will leave nothing but silence again.
Tell your sister the old methods are getting expensive.
He's bought and sold three governments in the same country, yet one petty rumor still keeps him up at night.
yet one petty rumor still keeps him up at night. If it were only a rumor, he wouldn't have come here.
That's why you're wasted carrying a gun. So this wasn't a lesson in hospitality. Sharp as ever.
Sharp as ever. Your mother still believes breaking people and forcing them into submission makes them loyal. You and the others are living proof of that long-running experiment.
You and the others are living proof of that long-running experiment. All she's doing is repeating the same outdated methods she learned from Father. Times have changed.
Times have changed. The world is moving fast, you know. If you want to persuade me, talk about yourself. Not my mother.
Not my mother. Fine. I couldn't care less about my sister's little family game. I want to build Baekya into something bigger
I want to build Baekya into something bigger an organization where contracts open more doors than guns. So J carries the gun, and I stand behind you.
and I stand behind you. Someone should give you a place of your own. As long as that place isn't behind you.
As long as that place isn't behind you. See? This is easier already. No need for either of us to pretend.
J is hunting Asha's uncle in Cuba tonight. Asha is in Cuba too. Asha's uncle—you mean Mikhail?
Asha's uncle—you mean Mikhail? Mother knew and still sent them both? Do you still not know your own mother? Your mother never walks into a risk she hasn't already weighed.
You find this amusing? You know, your mother always accepts the risk of getting caught in a trap she designed herself.
Sometimes it’s chilling. Other times I wonder how someone can be so foolish. Her obsession with that fake family of hers will be what destroys Baekya.
Her obsession with that fake family of hers will be what destroys Baekya.
Chapter 4 HOME
MATANZAS, CUBASEVERNY KONTUR MERCENARY COMPOUND
MATANZAS, CUBASEVERNY KONTUR MERCENARY COMPOUND
Damn!
VARADERO COAST, CUBAMIKHAIL’S VILLA
VARADERO COAST, CUBAMIKHAIL’S VILLA
You're Mikhail Volkov. Asha... It's good to see you. So you still remember my name.
So you still remember my name. I've waited a long time to face you.
Did you hear that? Let’s check.
Contact!
So you were waiting for me to come for you.
So you were waiting for me to come for you. Every day. You killed my father, left me in that place, and now you have the nerve to come looking for me.
and now you have the nerve to come looking for me. Asha... no. I didn't kill your father. When your father died,
When your father died, everyone connected to us was being hunted. I hid you where no one would find you to keep you safe.
I hid you where no one would find you to keep you safe. I was going to come back when it was safe. You call that safe?
I needed somewhere no one could find you. But you never came back for me.
Cha Yura found you and took you before a year had even passed.
You show up after all these years, and now you expect me to believe you? Baekya made sure no one could reach you. Then Cha Yura taught you to hate the people who were trying to bring you home.
Then Cha Yura taught you to hate the people who were trying to bring you home. Don't speak about my family. The people you call family
The people you call family killed your real family.
Contact!
Move forward! Contact!
Damn!
Cha Yura told you your aunt and I killed him, didn't she?
Cha Yura told you your aunt and I killed him, didn't she? She told me the truth. You betrayed my father, sent assassins to kill him,
You betrayed my father, sent assassins to kill him, then took everything he had his money, his organization, all of it. Asha.
Asha. Did you really believe that? She made up that ridiculous story so she could make you hers. How badly has that crazy bitch brainwashed you?
How badly has that crazy bitch brainwashed you? Watch your mouth.
Snap out of it, Asha! Baekya killed your father. J did it. You were there!
You're lying! I don't remember. Why do you think J left you at the hotel and went alone after she learned I was the target?
after she learned I was the target? Think about it! Stop! She knew who I was. She knew what would happen if you met me.
She knew what would happen if you met me. I said stop. Fine. No matter what I say, you won't believe me.
No matter what I say, you won't believe me. Then ask J yourself. Is she here? She'll be here soon.
She'll be here soon. Then I'll make you face the truth.
Go on. Ask her yourself. Asha... Why are you here?
Sis, answer me. Did you know from the start that the target was my uncle?
Look at me. Yes... I knew.
Then did you really kill my father? Sis... tell me you didn't.
Answer me!
Answer me! Yes. I did. I'm sorry...
I'm sorry... Don't say that! So that's what it was. The pity.
The pity. The guilt. One hand holding me, the other pushing me away. Asha...
Don't say my name like that! You never wanted to get me out of Baekya.
You shook me up with all that talk of giving me a new life but all you wanted was your guilt out of sight. I just wanted you to have a life beyond this.
I just wanted you to have a life beyond this. I meant that. You took my father's life. What gives you the right to decide how I live mine?
What gives you the right to decide how I live mine? Now choose. The woman who killed your father, or your own blood.
The woman who killed your father, or your own blood.
Finish it. Then come back to your real home.
Asha... Why? What are you doing? It's already...
It's already... too late. Asha! Untie me first!
Asha, please come to your senses. Do you really think Baekya loves you?
Do you really think Baekya loves you? They stole you from us! To them, you're nothing but bait. A weapon!
Shut the hell up! Asha, stop! It's over!
Asha! Look at me! Stop! Asha! Please, snap out of it!
Asha... please. That's enough. Please.
Volkov is dead. Baekya has lost control of the operation.
The operation failed. J and Asha survived.
J and Asha survived. Jimmy has them both. Bring them home.
My father wasn't a good man. I knew that even as a child. But he was my father.
But he was my father. My only family. Then one day, I lost the only family I had. I was left all alone.
I was left all alone. A cold, lonely, empty place... I kept waiting there for someone to come and get me.
I will never forget what you did. And I don't forgive you. Whatever you say, Baekya is my home now.
Whatever you say, Baekya is my home now. I don't want to go back to a cold, lonely place ever again.
But you're still my family, Sis. That's not something you get to end on your own.
So don't ever think about leaving me. Wherever you go, I'll find you.
I'll kill everyone you care about, then drag you back to my side. That's the only punishment I've chosen for you.
That's the only punishment I've chosen for you. Asha...
Don't think I don't know. You're always longing for some life you left behind somewhere.
Stop making me the bad sister.
The people from Baekya have arrived. LONDON, ENGLANDASHCOMBE PENTHOUSE
LONDON, ENGLANDASHCOMBE PENTHOUSE
Hey, old lady.
Hey, old lady. Do you have any idea what those useless daughters of yours just cost me? I'm sorry. Baekya will cover the loss.
I can make the money back before lunch. What you cost me was the room. Everyone at that table thinks my word comes cheap now.

Everyone at that table thinks my word comes cheap now. How do you plan to repay that humiliation? Volkov was supposed to reach American custody alive. Did you give a single thought to how far up the chain this went
Did you give a single thought to how far up the chain this went or who had to be involved to make it happen? And your worthless daughters ruined the whole thing.
And your worthless daughters ruined the whole thing. It will not happen again. Do I have to keep looking up at you?
Listen carefully. My grandfather thought loyalty could be bought forever.
My grandfather thought loyalty could be bought forever. My father grew sentimental about the same old hound. But here's the thing, old lady. I'm not like my grandfather or my father.
I'm not like my grandfather or my father. Baekya is useful while it obeys. Fail me again, and I won't call you in.
and I won't call you in. I'll call whoever replaces you.
Are we finished?
Get out of my sight!
What was her brother's name again? Elias Vale. Call him. I want to meet him.
Elias Vale speaking. Mr. Ashcombe would like to see you. Today.
Mr. Ashcombe would like to see you. Today. Please tell him I'd be delighted.
Beautiful day, for once.
Home really is the best. Cuba was awful.
The food was terrible, power kept going out, and the air-conditioning didn't work. Stop talking and eat. Still as charming as ever.
Still as charming as ever. Aren't you happy to see your little sister? It was nice and quiet for a while.
It was nice and quiet for a while. Seriously, what a jerk!
Sis, say something to him.
Mom, send me somewhere nice next time. There are still so many places I haven't seen.
I told you to stop talking and eat. Oh, come on.
How's the wound? Dogyeom... That's new.
That's new. You actually used my name. What if we left all of this behind and started over somewhere else?
What if we left all of this behind and started over somewhere else? Do you have the courage for that?
I suppose not... We've come too far. Clean that wound properly. Turn in early.
J, three years already. I figured coming back wouldn’t be easy.Hana is doing well. Thought you’d want to know.
J, three years already. I figured coming back wouldn’t be easy.Hana is doing well. Thought you’d want to know.

3 MONTHS LATER SEOUL, REPUBLIC OF KOREA
Do you know her?
No.
You left your shadow in the hall Where every mirror learned my face
Where every mirror learned my face I thought the distance would be kind
I thought the distance would be kind It only taught the dark your name If I return, don’t call it home
If I return, don’t call it home Just leave the hallway light down low I may not be the one you knew I may not know which way to go
I may not know which way to go When morning finds me at your door Don’t ask me where I’ve been so long If I return, just hold the quiet
If I return, just hold the quiet Till we know which part came home
